events.text: A side gig client says your payment is 'being processed'. The excuse feels rehearsed.

choices.label: Message politely and give one more week
choices.resultText: They pay eventually. Your reputation with them stays intact.

choices.label: Escalate and demand a timeline
choices.resultText: You get paid faster, but you burn some goodwill.

choices.label: Cut your losses and move on
choices.resultText: You do not lose everything, and your stress eases.

events.text: A good review drops unexpectedly. Someone shares your work with friends.

choices.label: Deliver one more 'premium' version
choices.resultText: You turn a small job into a chain of higher-paying repeats.

choices.label: Stay consistent and scale slowly
choices.resultText: You avoid burnout and still grow your income.

choices.label: Chase the spotlight and overpromise
choices.resultText: You earn big now, but the complaints later feel worse.

events.text: Your next level needs equipment. The problem is the shop looks expensive.

choices.label: Buy the basic tools you can afford
choices.resultText: You start with less, but you still start.

choices.label: Invest big to buy the best gear
choices.resultText: The tools pay for themselves later - if you survive the first month.

choices.label: Borrow tools from a friend
choices.resultText: Your friend trusts you more. You feel less alone in the grind.

events.text: You keep saying 'just one more shift'. Your body stops agreeing with your plans.

choices.label: Take a real rest day
choices.resultText: It hurts to skip the cash. But your energy returns.

choices.label: Push through to finish strong
choices.resultText: You finish the work, but your body feels like it filed complaints.

choices.label: Reduce scope and keep quality
choices.resultText: You deliver something better than a rushed version.

events.text: A friend asks to join your hustle. It could help both of you - or complicate everything.

choices.label: Teach them and share profits
choices.resultText: You build trust. The extra hands make your next job easier.

choices.label: Keep it private to protect quality
choices.resultText: You stay focused. Your work improves, even if it feels lonely.

choices.label: Ignore the boundary and set no rules
choices.resultText: You earn something, but the trust breaks fast.
